article.title: Invoca推出Google Ads訊息代理beta，連接查詢、預約與轉換資料
article.title_en: Invoca launches a Google Ads messaging-agent beta linking conversations and conversion data
article.summary: Invoca於10月28日公布Messaging Agents For Google Ads，表示可透過RCS for Business回應廣告帶來的訊息、篩選潛在客戶及處理預約；目前屬beta。
article.summary_en: Invoca announced Messaging Agents For Google Ads on October 28, describing RCS for Business agents that answer ad-driven messages, qualify leads and book appointments. The product is in beta.
article.why: 對旅遊、電訊及家居服務等需要諮詢的行業，值得評估搜尋廣告後的對話承接與CRM回傳，並建立清楚的人手轉介條件。
article.why_en: Considered-purchase sectors such as travel, telecom and home services can assess post-ad conversations, CRM feedback and human handoff rules.
article.next_step: 先確認目標市場及beta資格，再用一項非敏感服務測試答案來源、預約準確度與轉介流程。
article.next_step_en: Confirm markets and beta eligibility, then test one non-sensitive service for answer grounding, booking accuracy and escalation.

highlights_en: Invoca describes access to brand knowledge and business systems for service coverage and booking data.
Its proposed flow connects Google clicks, Invoca conversations and CRM revenue, with outcomes sent back to Google Ads.
Conversations involving protected health information are not yet supported.
article.detail:
Invoca於10月28日公布Messaging Agents For Google Ads，表示可透過RCS for Business回應廣告帶來的訊息、篩選潛在客戶及處理預約；目前屬beta。

Invoca表示代理可使用品牌知識與企業系統，查詢服務覆蓋及預約資料。

公司描述由Google點擊、Invoca對話到CRM收入的連接，並可將結果回傳Google Ads。

產品暫不支援涉及受保護健康資訊的對話。

對旅遊、電訊及家居服務等需要諮詢的行業，值得評估搜尋廣告後的對話承接與CRM回傳，並建立清楚的人手轉介條件。

先確認目標市場及beta資格，再用一項非敏感服務測試答案來源、預約準確度與轉介流程。

功能及量度路徑按Invoca公告歸因；未獨立測試成交效果，公告亦未列出完整適用市場。
article.detail_en:
Invoca announced Messaging Agents For Google Ads on October 28, describing RCS for Business agents that answer ad-driven messages, qualify leads and book appointments. The product is in beta.

Invoca describes access to brand knowledge and business systems for service coverage and booking data.

Its proposed flow connects Google clicks, Invoca conversations and CRM revenue, with outcomes sent back to Google Ads.

Conversations involving protected health information are not yet supported.

Considered-purchase sectors such as travel, telecom and home services can assess post-ad conversations, CRM feedback and human handoff rules.

Confirm markets and beta eligibility, then test one non-sensitive service for answer grounding, booking accuracy and escalation.

Capabilities and measurement flows are attributed to Invoca. Sales outcomes were not independently tested, and the release does not list all eligible markets.
